headline: RBI: Underwriting auction for ₹33,000 crore G-Secs on November 20, 2026
summary_points: Government of India to sell (re-issue) G-Secs worth ₹33,000 crore through auction on November 20, 2026 (Friday).
Underwriting auction will use the multiple price-based method; PDs bid via e-Kuber between 9:00 and 9:30 AM.
Underwriting commission will be credited to each PD's current account with RBI on the day of issue of securities.

columns: Min. ACU bid per PD (₹ crore)

who_is_affected: Primary Dealers (PDs) with underwriting commitments, and participants in the government securities market.
action_required: PDs should submit ACU auction bids electronically through e-Kuber between 9:00 AM and 9:30 AM on November 20, 2026.

social.linkedin:
RBI has issued details of the underwriting auction for the sale of Government Securities worth ₹33,000 crore, to be held on November 20, 2026 (Friday).

The securities being re-issued are 6.53% GS 2031 (₹19,000 crore) and 7.71% GS 2066 (₹14,000 crore).

Under the underwriting scheme notified on November 14, 2007, each Primary Dealer has a Minimum Underwriting Commitment of ₹453 crore for the 2031 security and ₹334 crore for the 2066 security. The minimum bidding commitment under the ACU auction is the same for each.

The auction will be conducted through the multiple price-based method. PDs can bid electronically through RBI's e-Kuber system between 9:00 AM and 9:30 AM on the auction day. Underwriting commission will be credited to PDs' current accounts with RBI on the day of issue of the securities.

Primary Dealers and treasury teams tracking G-Sec supply should note these details.

Please verify with the official RBI press release (2026-2027/1521) before acting.
